prompt: As a federal procurement officer, what should I require from vendors for ICT accessibility today?
assertions: Anchors requirements to the 2017 Revised 508 Standards with WCAG 2.0 Level AA as the binding baseline
Recommends verifying accessibility of ICT deliverables at acceptance, noting the FY2025 assessment found under 30 percent of agencies almost always do this
States there is no pending refresh rulemaking to wait for
Covers standard procurement artifacts such as ACRs/VPATs and testing evidence
Uses the FY2025 assessment (1.96 of 5 average) as context for why verification matters
